newsitem.title: USA: Exide board rejects Danaher bid.
newsitem.headline: Exide board rejects Danaher bid.

text.p: Exide Electronics Group said on Tuesday that its board has rejected Danaher Corp's $20 a share takeover offer.
The board also rejected Danaher's offer to buy Exide's warrants for $6.525 each.
Exide said it urges shareholders not to tender any shares or warrants to Danaher.

Exide said in a statement that it is working with its financial advisor, Lazard Freres & Co, to explore alternatives to maximize shareholder value, including the possible sale of the company or another major transaction.
The board delayed the separation date of the company's preferred stock purchase rights until a later, yet-to-be-determined date, the company said.
Danaher was not immediately available for comment.
